description: Use when the user asks: 'what's the ISWC for X?', 'who wrote X?', 'tell me about song X', 'is this song registered?'. Get the details of a single listed work by ISWC or work UUID. Returns the credits, one per person with each role marked confirmed or not confirmed by that person, and the person's IPI; each writer's share of the work, only when the owner chose to show shares AND that writer confirmed it themselves (with how many writers have); the recordings' ISRCs, audio analysis (BPM, key, energy) when the audio has been analysed, streaming links (Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube), AI origin (what the owner declared, with ACRCloud's detection beside it), the work's PICA score, and whether the owner is taking licensing enquiries, as a markdown summary. Fields with no data are omitted. → then: directory_lookup_person (a credited writer, by the credit's global_creator_id or IPI), directory_search_recordings (find similar tracks by audio)
name: directory_lookup_work
title: Look up a work
